tribulations.name: Meridian Tribulation
tribulations.desc: Thin lances of heaven-testing Qi, aimed at the channels you just opened.

tribulations.name: Lightning Tribulation
tribulations.desc: Four bolts a wave. The first real test of a golden core.

tribulations.name: Heart Demon Tribulation
tribulations.desc: Slow, patient strikes that follow what you regret.

tribulations.name: Elemental Tribulation
tribulations.desc: Wind, water and fire in sequence, never the same twice.

tribulations.name: Spatial Tribulation
tribulations.desc: The blow lands before the bolt is seen.

tribulations.name: Bloodline Tribulation
tribulations.desc: Heaven tests the body you were born in, not the one you built.

tribulations.name: Heavenly Judgment
tribulations.desc: A verdict, not a test. Five waves, four bolts each.

tribulations.name: Grand Tribulation
tribulations.desc: The tribulation that ends most cultivators' stories.

tribulations.name: Dao Tribulation
tribulations.desc: Heaven asks whether your law is worth the sky it occupies.

tribulations.name: Sovereign Tribulation
tribulations.desc: Six bolts a wave, six waves: the arithmetic of mastery.

tribulations.name: Primordial Tribulation
tribulations.desc: The first sky, remembering what it was before you.
